Name: miss caroline portraits
Author: deleted56164987
Description:
[size=4]disclaimer! my mods still work, however, in order to use the seasonal version, you must use the legacy version instead of
the most recent one.[/size]

pierre doesn't deserve her tbh

i wasn't satisfied with her first version, so i made some tweaks.

-----------------------------

this mod has two versions, vanilla and seasonal.

- vanilla will only replace her main outfit, beach and winter. after downloading, drop it inside your mods folder.

- seasonal replaces all of her outfits with brand new ones. you will need
Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic by Poltergeister in order for it to work. after downloading it, drop the 'assets' folder inside [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters and let it override.

this mod is also compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/37803135]Hitme11[/url]'s Caroline is Single.

 -----------------------------

thank you so much for the endorsements and kind comments! i really appreciate it :]
